about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Kanka!

Kanka, meaning 'buddy' or 'close friend' in Turkish, is at the heart of our in-development multiplayer, third-person shooter (TPS) action RPG. We're building a vibrant sci-fi universe where teamwork, strategy, and explosive combat collide.

Embark on an Epic Sci-Fi Adventure:

Dive into a galaxy filled with unique challenges, formidable foes, and untold mysteries. Kanka is designed from the ground up for a cooperative multiplayer experience. Whether you're exploring strange new worlds, battling alien creatures, or undertaking perilous missions, you'll do it best with your Kankas by your side.

Key Features We're Building:

  • Intense Multiplayer TPS Action: Engage in fast-paced, tactical third-person combat where coordination with your squad is key to survival and success.

  • Deep Action RPG Progression: Customize your character, unlock powerful abilities, discover and upgrade a vast arsenal of futuristic weaponry and gear.

  • A Universe to Explore (and Conquer): Journey through diverse and visually stunning sci-fi environments, each with its own lore and challenges. (This will expand as development progresses!)

  • Play With Your Kankas: True to its name, Kanka emphasizes the power of friendship and teamwork. Form your squad, support each other, and share the spoils of your adventures.

Early Development & Our Vision:

Kanka is currently in the early stages of development by a passionate team dedicated to creating an engaging and memorable multiplayer experience. We're excited to share our journey with you through our developer vlogs and community updates.

What to Expect (As We Grow):

  • An evolving storyline and expanding world.

  • More character customization options.

  • New enemy types and challenging boss encounters.

  • Regular updates based on community feedback.

Join Our Community & Shape Kanka!

Wishlist Kanka now and follow our development to stay updated on our progress. We're eager to hear your thoughts and ideas as we build this game together. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping Kanka into the ultimate sci-fi multiplayer adventure.

The galaxy awaits, Kanka. Are you ready?
